## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete issue and resulting behavior. Include a small before/after
example when it clarifies the change.

## Validation

List relevant tests and the result of `composer check`.

## Compatibility and rights

- [ ] Public API, named arguments, validation and serialization changes are documented.
- [ ] Documentation/examples and CHANGELOG.md reflect the change.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic or explicitly redistributable data.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the MIT license and retained required notices.
